author: META_A
verificationMeaning: 재개점 대비 원문 bytes·UID 순서·기존 검토 bytes·표본 재사용의 구조적 보존만 확인한다. 내부 과거 해시 불일치는 별도 공개하며 정답/해설 승인이나 품질 PASS로 해석하지 않는다.
identityResolution: Source position is preserved by raw-byte equality. Canonical questionUid order is joined by sourceArchiveFile + sourceOrdinal through baseline/current identity and metadata maps, progress, review and four-slot arrays; no new UID is generated.

hashAlgorithms.itemAndOrderHashes: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys and preserved array order
hashAlgorithms.sampleSourceFingerprints: Prior verify-packet.cjs field order: QBODY={content,choices,image}; QFULL={content,choices,answer,solution,image}; SHA-256 of JSON.stringify. SOURCE_ONLY question text is separately protected by raw UTF-8 stem hashes.
hashAlgorithms.gitBlobs: Git SHA-1 blob header plus bytes
